candidates.name: RMS
candidates.description: RMS is a cloud-native property management platform designed for the hospitality industry, including hotels, motels, holiday parks, campgrounds, and serviced apartments. Its main functionality includes automating operations such as front desk work, maintenance, and revenue management, while providing tools for guest reservations, payments, and reporting. Key features include an online booking engine that allows guests to book directly, automated payment processing, and integration with various property systems like Airbnb and Nogit. The platform aims to enhance efficiency, increase direct bookings, and improve guest experiences through personalized service and analytics.
candidates.rationale: RMS directly overlaps Mews as a cloud hospitality property-management platform for reservations, payments, operations, revenue management, and guest experience.

candidates.name: Kunggy
candidates.description: Kunggy is a property management software designed for hotels and hospitality businesses. It streamlines operations from booking to check-out, enhancing communication between front desk staff and revenue management. Key features include a guest upselling process, automated pricing based on occupancy levels, an intuitive dashboard for tracking bookings and inventory, and integration with various hotel services such as restaurants and spa facilities. The platform also offers tools for managing multiple properties, track audit trails, and create custom websites for direct reservations.
candidates.rationale: Both provide hotel property-management software spanning reservations, front-desk operations, pricing, integrations, and guest experience for hospitality operators.

candidates.name: Yanolja Cloud Solution
candidates.description: Yanolja Cloud Solution offers a cloud-based hotel management system designed to streamline operations for hotels, restaurants, and other hospitality businesses. The software includes features such as a property management system (PMS), online reservation system, reputation management, revenue management, and mobile guest self-service portals. It supports various property types, including hotels, resorts, hostels, and vacation rentals, and provides tools for managing room rates, credit card verification, and customer interactions through a centralized platform. Additionally, the software integrates with over 130 booking channels and offers real-time analytics and reporting capabilities to enhance operational efficiency.
candidates.rationale: Both provide cloud hotel property-management platforms covering reservations, operations, payments, revenue management, and guest experience for hospitality operators.

It offers a comparison of over 200 software systems, including revenue management, marketing, customer experience, and operational support, allowing users to select the best technology for their needs. Key features include access to vetted experts in various fields, a tech index for quick recommendations, and a network of over 1,000 professionals who provide expertise in areas such as revenue optimization, guest communication, and digital transformation.
candidates.rationale: HotelMinder is a software-comparison and consulting marketplace, not a hotel property-management platform used for reservations, payments, and operations.
